title: Your Home Loan EMI: What RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra's Decision Means
description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra and the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) are meeting to decide on key interest rates. Their decision on the "repo rate" directly i.

faq.q: What is the current repo rate?
faq.a: As of the RBI's June 2026 monetary policy review, the benchmark repo rate stands at 5.25%.

faq.q: When will the RBI's decision be announced?
faq.a: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra is scheduled to announce the Monetary Policy Committee's decision on August 5, 2026, at 10 AM.

faq.q: Will my home loan EMI definitely change after the announcement?
faq.a: If you have a floating-rate home loan, your EMI might change if the repo rate is revised. However, if the repo rate remains unchanged, your EMI will likely stay the same, unless your bank makes independent adjustments.

faq.q: Why do economists expect the repo rate to remain unchanged?
faq.a: Economists generally anticipate a "status quo" (no change) because the RBI is taking a cautious, data-driven approach, balancing domestic inflationary pressures with the need to support economic growth. India's retail inflation was 4.4% in June 2026, which is above the RBI's 4% target, but core inflation remains within a comfortable range.
